channel.title: Wonderfall Blog
channel.description: Practical guides to Mac desktop customization: snow and rain overlays, seasonal effects, decorative lights and custom images.

item.title: How to Give Your Mac a Christmas Theme: Wallpaper, Snow and Lights
item.description: Turn your Mac or MacBook desktop into a Christmas scene: a festive wallpaper, falling snow, menu bar lights, a snow drift and a New Year variation.

item.title: SnowMyScreen Is Now Wonderfall: What’s New in Version 1.2
item.description: SnowMyScreen is now Wonderfall. Version 1.2 adds snow drifts and a shovel, Christmas lights with eight scenes, rain, leaves, petals and weather matching.

item.title: How to Put Christmas Lights on Your Mac Desktop
item.description: Hang animated Christmas lights along your Mac menu bar, pick a scene, colors and glow, and keep them over your windows or only on the desktop.

item.title: Animated Snow on Your Mac: Wallpaper, Screensaver or Overlay?
item.description: Moving wallpaper, snow screensaver or desktop overlay: what each option does on a Mac and how to keep snow falling over your own wallpaper while you work.

item.title: How to Add Snow to Your Mac Desktop (and Other Seasonal Effects)
item.description: Set up falling snow on your Mac, customize the motion and your own images, and explore Wonderfall’s seasonal effects without changing your wallpaper.
